svg.title: Val Ark: The tool wall
svg.desc: A workshop pegboard. Tools hang in six groups, each on a hook with a guide tag: Containers (Docker Engine, Compose + Buildx, Registry); Web and network (Caddy, Headscale, Gitea); Build (CMake + Ninja, Go, JDK + Git for Windows); Storage and backup (rclone, restic, age + croc); Monitoring (Prometheus, node_exporter, Alertmanager); Data and everyday (DuckDB, KeePassXC + Ventoy). A green lamp on a name plate means the tool has a run check; a ring means guide only (JDK, Git for Windows, KeePassXC and Ventoy: a window app, another system, or too big to try). On the bench below: a note, one list (data/dev-stack.tsv, a line per project; add a line and its card appears in Library, Developer stack; none is hand-made); and a test box marked "Does it run?" with a lit lamp: the newest copy for this box is unpacked on the bench, run with a time limit, then thrown away; nothing is installed; a pass is remembered for a week and a failure shows on the Health page.
